title: FaultLine adversarial scenario coverage matrix

rows.scenario: Codex Stop events occur on dirty worktrees before a commit.
rows.detail: Turn tree snapshots exist; clean checkpoints may be skipped.

rows.scenario: Witness returns inconsistent verdicts across three reruns.
rows.detail: No stable state and no A-grade proof.

rows.scenario: Older states cannot compile or import the witness harness.
pnpm-lock.yaml changes inside the investigated range.
rows.detail: Heterogeneous environment fingerprints refuse single-image proof.

rows.scenario: Execution budget ends before a 1-minimal set is certified.
rows.detail: Return associated set without unsupported exact-cause claims.

rows.scenario: Two hunks together are necessary and sufficient for failure.
Failure is repaired then reintroduced later in history.
rows.detail: Non-monotonic PASS/FAIL transitions must remain visible.

rows.scenario: Single-file source change flips a structured witness from pass to fail.

note: This is a coverage matrix, not an end-to-end benchmark. Unit and integration tests assert localization, structured INCOMPATIBLE_STATE classification, env homogeneity, and turn snapshots. Rows do not claim unique semantic root causes.
